logp.method_description: Distilled water and n-octanol were mixed vigorously for 24 h at 25 °C, to promote solvent saturation in both phases, before the experiments. A small amount of Ir1-Ir3 was added in a mixed solution of 3 mL of water (saturated with n-octanol) and 3 mL of n-octanol (saturated with water). The solution was shaken for 24 h and centrifuged at 5000 rpm for 10 min. The concentrations of the Ir1-Ir3 in both phases were measured by UV-vis absorption spectra. The oil/water partition coefficients were calculated using the equation: log Po/w = log (AO/AW), where AO and AW represent the absorbance of the complex in the n-octanol phase and water phase, respectively.
